documentary_findings.publication_rule: CONFIRMED_BOUNDED: FDA states it intends to make advisory-committee background material public no later than two business days before the meeting, with explicit exceptions when prior posting is not possible.
documentary_findings.document_channel: CONFIRMED: FDA guidance covers sponsor/applicant briefing materials and FDA public-release process; meeting pages expose Event Materials and may publish combined FDA/sponsor briefing documents.
documentary_findings.provenance: PARTIAL: source identity is visible for many materials, but combined FDA/sponsor documents defeat a universal deterministic FDA-versus-sponsor separation rule unless document-level structure is parsed under a frozen rule.
documentary_findings.pit_clock: NOT_PROVED_FOR_HISTORICAL_SAMPLE: the intended deadline and current page presence do not by themselves prove an exact first-public-availability timestamp for every historical document; pages can be updated and errata can appear.
documentary_findings.incrementality: NOT_PROVED: sponsor trial disclosures, meeting announcements, public dockets and prior regulatory disclosures can contain overlapping information before briefing-material publication.
documentary_findings.legacy_distinctness: NO_EXACT_DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIED_WITHIN_FROZEN_LINEAGE_SET; causal channel remains distinct from SEC ownership disclosure, due-bill settlement and CVR contract families.

cross_examination: Two-business-day language is an intended publication deadline, not a guaranteed uniform timestamp.
The April 30 2026 ODAC page lists combined FDA/AstraZeneca briefing documents and later errata, showing provenance/revision handling is material.
Meeting announcements and public-comment dockets exist before the meeting and can reveal application identity and controversy context.
A substantive-concern classifier can become researcher-discretion leakage unless lexical/structural features are frozen before any outcome access.
Advisory committee recommendations are non-binding; later FDA decisions cannot label the pre-meeting document event ex ante.

blockers: BLOCK_DATA: exact point-in-time first-public timestamps are not yet proven reconstructible across a historical sample
BLOCK_CLAIM_LEVEL: regulator-authored substantive concern and incremental novelty cannot yet be classified deterministically across combined/revised documents without outcome-aware judgment
not_blocked: documentary existence of scheduled briefing-material release process
causal distinctness as a regulatory-document information channel

claim_restriction: Retain only: FDA advisory-committee briefing materials form a real scheduled public-document channel that can expose agency/sponsor regulatory framing before an open meeting. Do not claim a uniform release timestamp, incremental information, direction, underreaction, alpha or economic effect until a separately frozen PIT timestamp/provenance/feature protocol is demonstrated.
